points.why: It notes the 24x speedup and growing request volume, but frames them as the cause of risk rather than stating the gain plainly as a benefit.
It traces volume overwhelming the two seniors into skim-and-approve review, names subtle join and filter errors, and says polished dashboards look authoritative to executives.
It covers juniors losing SQL skill and the reviewer pipeline thinning at 18–24 months, but states this with certainty rather than labeling it speculative.
It proposes stakes-tiered review with sampling, reconciliation to source-of-truth totals, regular hand-written SQL exercises and an added reviewer, all while keeping the tool.

pitfalls.why: It recommends a staged rollout with safeguards, not abandoning the tool.
